blocks.h2: Signs Your Sump Pump Needs Attention
blocks.intro: Check it before the wet season:

tiles.h3: It Runs for Days After Rain
tiles.body: High groundwater can keep it busy. If it never rests, it may be undersized or failing.

tiles.h3: It Doesn't Start When You Test It
tiles.body: Pour water in the pit. No start means a float or motor problem.
Worn bearings or debris in the impeller.

tiles.h3: It's More Than 7 to 10 Years Old
tiles.body: Pumps that run often wear out sooner.

blocks.intro: McHenry sits on the Fox River near the Chain O'Lakes. In July 2017, heavy rain and river flooding led the state to declare McHenry County a disaster area.

items.h3: High Groundwater Near the River and Lakes
items.body: When the river and lakes are high, groundwater rises too. Sump pumps near the water can run for days at a time and wear out faster.
Storms that raise the water also knock out power. A battery backup keeps pumping when the main pump stops.
About 4 in 10 McHenry homes went up between 1990 and 2009. A builder-grade pump that's never been replaced is overdue.
A discharge line that freezes sends water back to the foundation. We route and protect it.

blocks.h2: Sump Pump Questions From McHenry Homeowners

items.q: My sump pump runs constantly in spring. Is that normal?
items.preview: Near the river and lakes, often yes. Make sure it's sized for it.
items.answer: Near the Fox River and the lakes, high groundwater can keep a pump running for days in spring. That's normal, but it means the pump wears faster and should be sized for the load. A backup is a must.

items.q: Do I need a battery backup sump pump?
items.preview: In McHenry County, yes, especially with a finished basement.
items.answer: Yes, especially if your basement is finished. High water and power outages often come together.

items.q: How long does a sump pump last?
items.preview: Usually 7 to 10 years, less if it runs often.
items.answer: Most last somewhere around 7 to 10 years. A pump that runs a lot near the water may need replacing sooner.

items.q: Can I install a bigger sump pump?
items.preview: Yes, if your pit and discharge can handle it.
items.answer: Yes. If your pump can't keep up, we can install a higher-capacity pump and make sure the pit and discharge line match it.

items.q: How much does sump pump installation cost in McHenry?
items.preview: It depends on the pump, pit and backup. You get a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the pump, any pit or check valve work and whether you add a backup. We give you a flat-rate price before any work begins.
